semantics.acquisition: actor-private field initializer executes in the owning actor context and spawn creates a structured child
semantics.representation: ActorRef is a capability and MUST NOT be represented as a forgeable integer or raw guest pointer
semantics.rebinding: v1 fixture uses immutable val capability state; mutable ActorRef state is outside this v1 promotion fixture
semantics.send: handler may invoke child.send(payload) through the retained capability
semantics.suspension: capability remains valid across await while the child remains live and generation-valid
semantics.lifecycle: parent termination owns descendant cancellation/drain and parent done does not settle until children finalize
semantics.dataBoundary: ActorRef is not ordinary serialized message data

evidenceRules: Host C callbacks do not count as compiler-guest evidence.
ABI/link proof does not count as unchanged-source parity.
A workflow with zero executed steps is infrastructure failure, not conformance evidence.
Java and LLVM parity requires this exact fixture bytes or a recorded fixture digest from this repository.
Embedded may claim only bounded-subset target execution until this exact source form is compiled and run on the target profile.
